Computer Vision Engineer, Reality Labs
Computer Vision Engineer, Reality Labs
Redmond, WA
Artificial Intelligence
+ 9 more
Apply now
The Reality Labs organization is helping more people around the world come together and connect through Virtual Reality and Wearables products. With global departments dedicated to research and development in computer vision, machine learning, haptics, social interaction, and more, Reality Labs is committed to advancing the state of the art through ongoing research and development. The potential to change the world is immense - and we’re just getting started.

Our Mixed Reality (XR) organization is focused on advanced research and development of machine perception technologies from early concepts to production level across all of Reality Labs' products and surfaces. These include Quest products, Meta Glasses and Family of Apps (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp). We develop core capabilities across a range of product domains including avatars, AR/VR remote presence and calling, commerce, content sharing, spatial computing, sensor calibration, and more.

In this role, you will be researching and applying a range of software, computer vision and machine learning techniques for solving challenges that bridge virtual and real worlds and will impact billions of people. We're addressing a variety of technical challenges in the areas of real-time image processing, 3D graphics, SLAM, scene reconstruction, machine perception, visualization and human interaction. As well there are opportunities to collaborate with researchers in Reality Labs (RL) and Facebook AI Research (FAIR).
Computer Vision Engineer, Reality Labs Responsibilities
Design and develop novel factory and online calibration algorithms for sensors and displays. Design and prototype automation for calibration in collaboration with mechanical engineers and prototyping technicians
Collaborate with cross-functional engineering and research teams from Reality Labs in computer vision and graphics
Participate in advanced research in computer vision that can be applied to Wearables and VR product development
Work with other engineers to bring new products to market
Contribute to engineering best practices, code quality standards, and technical culture within your team
Minimum Qualifications
Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Degree must be completed prior to joining Meta
2+ years of experience developing and designing Computer Vision and Perception algorithms for robotics technologies and systems
Experience in C++ development
Prototyping and engineering experience in at least one relevant specialization area in Computer Vision or Perception for Robotics: Camera Calibration, Online Calibration, State Estimation, Sensor Fusion, 3D Reconstruction, Camera Pose Estimation, Structure-From-Motion
Preferred Qualifications
Masters or PhD degree in Computer Science, Computer Vision, Robotics, or a related technical field
Publication track record at conferences such as SIGGRAPH, CVPR, NeurIPS, ECCV, ICCV, ISMAR, ICML, RSS, ICRA, IROS, etc
Industry experience working on projects such as: Camera Calibration, Online Calibration, State Estimation, Sensor Fusion, 3D Reconstruction, Camera Pose Estimation, Structure-From-Motion
About Meta
Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.
For those who live in or expect to work from California if hired for this position, please click here for additional information.
